body:
MMOBags | Professional RPG Container Solution
The ultimate lightweight, high-performance bag system for modern servers.


✨ Key Features
Most bag plugins fail when a player's inventory is full. MMOBags features a high-performance vacuum system designed to ensure item collection regardless of inventory space.

Intelligent Vacuum Pickup: Bypasses standard inventory limits to suck whitelisted items directly into the pouch.
Anti-Dupe : Built on the PersistentDataContainer API to ensure 100% item safety without external databases.
Visual Flair & Hex Support: Full support for &#RRGGBB hex colors and Custom Model Data for custom resource packs.
Dynamic Progress Bars: Visual lore updates showing real-time capacity with color-coded status bars.
Multi-Line Flavor Lore: Add deep immersion with custom lore strings using the /bageditlore command.
Optimized Performance: Low CPU impact background tasks and event handling.


Admin Commands & Permissions
mmobags.admin

/bagcreate <type> <tier> <whitelist/blacklist> - Turn held item into a bag.
/baggive <player> <type> <tier> - Give a bag to a specific player.
/bagadditem <type> - Whitelist the held item for a specific bag type.
/bageditlore <text> - Add custom flavor lore (Use _ for spaces, | for new lines).
/bagreload - Instantly reload all configurations and translations.


Localization
Includes a full messages.yml with built-in support for multiple languages:
English | Spanish | Portuguese | Russian
